reason: Allows disabling hardware write protection (CR50/H1), which is a critical security boundary. Unsafe if exposed to compromised renderer.
Triggers installation of third-party code. Potential for RCE if the 'last found app' path can be manipulated or spoofed.
Writes raw, unsanitized data to the OS clipboard. This can be used to exploit vulnerabilities in clipboard parsers of other applications.
Allows deletion of user data (bookmarks) via IPC. If the interface is not properly scoped or permissions checked, it allows data loss.
Allows modification of user data. Potential for phishing (changing URLs) or data corruption.
